defects_found.location: main.tex, Related work: description of wang2025llms
defects_found.description: Unsupported characterisation, and the novelty claim built on it ('closest prior result', 'they do not test...') is unsupported. The paper says Wang et al. show models accept individual incorrect options when verified alone, relate isolated verification to choice, and still choose when the correct option is replaced and a no-answer option is offered. The citation record only holds a search-snippet summary (least-incorrect-option, accuracy persists when the correct option is removed). The full text was never read, so the paper cannot say what they did or did not test.

defects_found.location: main.tex, Related work: jeong2025comparative, ji2026candidate and wen2024know described in detail
defects_found.description: Claims about these papers rest on snippets or abstract pages only. For example, ji2026 'exclude all-wrong pools from their stratified and ranking analyses' and jeong 'pairwise comparisons amplify biased preferences' (bias toward superficial attributes) are generalised beyond what was read. The paper discloses a snippet-only reading only for zhang2026selected.
